description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for 'git rev-list' command handling unexpected object types within a Git repository. It sets up various test scenarios, verifies correct behavior or expected failures, and checks error messages related to non-standard object types in Git objects such as blobs, trees, commits, and tags.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success, runs the specified commands, and verifies the outcome.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, verifying error conditions.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files or strings to expected results.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for specific patterns in command output to verify error messages.
